client: Juniper & Ash Home
client_industry: e-commerce
start: 2021-01
end: 2021-04
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Next.js

metrics:

The review is from: Juniper & Ash Home

text: Tobias was easy to work with throughout the rebuild of our storefront. He communicated clearly, kept us updated without making things feel complicated, and was responsive when we had questions.
